scope: 100 measured task responses, 6 extra warmups excluded. Synthetic adult-only lab. No RAG/no product changes. Installed weights only.

protocol.scope: Raw local model with gold context; no RAG, backend, schema repair, generated code execution or application guards.
protocol.acceptance: Each case: all prewritten semantic criteria; exact JSON/schema separate; critical factual errors, answer leakage and unsupported mastery are failures. Full pass requires both semantic and technical validity. No readiness claim from this small synthetic sample.
protocol.holdout_policy: Freeze prompt before any holdout call. No tuning after holdout; future tuning retires it. Test families differ but curriculum concepts overlap: limited within-domain holdout, not generalisation proof.
protocol.latency: Warmup excluded; every planned task incl timeout/error in denominator. Report full-response p50/p95 and server TTFT separately, no streaming UX claim. Timeout120s. Single concurrency; load test1–2 deferred until quality gate.

freeze.reason: One common prompt revision completed on dev; persistent failures. Fixed v2 used for both models, no claim of optimal prompt. No holdout generations yet.

decision: Neither tested reasoning-off configuration passes all roles. 9B is a better next tuning candidate on this limited suite, not production-ready. Do not attribute these failures to retrieval.
limitations: Limited within-curriculum holdout; 15 scenarios per model, two repeats are correlated.
Different quantizations: 4B Q6_K, 9B Q4_K_M; compares actual deployment configurations.
Warm sequential local requests; shared prefix may be cached, no cold-start/concurrency/end-user streaming claim.
GPU memory snapshots are not peaks. GPU max requested, actual device-layer placement not independently traced.
API provides output-token counts but no explicit finish_reason; content completion manually reviewed.
Semantic judgments by two AI reviewers with primary adjudication; no independent human teacher review.
Prompt v2 frozen after one common revision; no claim it is optimal. reasoning:on untested.
